integrity.description: The final screenshot is a genuine capture of the application, not a mock-up.
integrity.visual_evidence: The screenshot 'mu_rhythm_config.png' matches the state of the GUI seen in the trajectory steps (window positions, background, etc.).

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target file is 'OpenBCI-EEG-S001-MotorImagery.txt'. In OpenBCI GUI, Channel 3 and 4 correspond to the motor cortex (C3 and C4). The Band Power widget must specifically show only these two channels. The final screenshot must be saved at '~/Documents/OpenBCI_GUI/Screenshots/mu_rhythm_config.png' and should show at least 5 seconds of elapsed time on the playback clock.
